caveats: This is the second federal lawsuit against former deputy Edwin Diaz, filed by a second former inmate (in custody March-September 2024) in early April 2026 (KATU says filed 'Friday', article published 2026-04-08, i.e. approx. 2026-04-03/04). Suit seeks jury trial and unspecified damages; no resolution reported, so 'ongoing' reflects status as of April 2026. OPB article was only partially retrievable but corroborates a second woman suing the same deputy. Diaz faces 25 criminal counts (indicted June 2025); no trial date set in sources. Deputy worked in the county jail; employing agency is the sheriff's office.
